content.simple_explanation: 'The Decision of the Panchayat' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Let us Read 8 The Decision of the Panchayat Once upon a time, there lived a farmer in a small village.
Since the farmer needed a source of water for his fields, he bought the well from his neighbour.
He refused to let the farmer take water from the well.
On asking why, he replied, “I sold only the well to you, not the water.
You cannot take it.” The worried farmer didn’t know what to do.
